exposure: Human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell sheet transplantation
cohort: Nude rats that underwent a hysterotomy procedure, with one uterine horn serving as a control and the other receiving stem cell sheet transplantation.
finding: Human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell sheet transplantation is feasible in a rat hysterotomy model and significantly reduces fibroblast infiltration and uterine scar fibrotic tissue formation, while promoting myometrial regeneration.
